caption:
110-SECOND GUIDED INVESTIGATION

Diffusion spreads dye down concentration gradients. The clock is accelerated: this is a millimetre-scale cell, not a full beaker mixing in seconds.

Magnified 1–4 mm closed microcell. Still-water diffusion only; no stirring or convection. Guide advances model time 22.5×; manual playback 1×. Colour is a concentration proxy. Drag to orbit; scroll to zoom.
